True def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    m = len(grid[0])
    base = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * n):
        br, rr = divmod(r, n)
        if br % 2:
            rr = n - 1 - rr
        row = []
        for c in range(3 * m):
            bc, cc = divmod(c, m)
            if bc % 2:
                cc = m - 1 - cc
            row.append(base[rr][cc])
        out.append(row)
    return out
